The *Saññojanaduka* is an Abhidhamma text situated within the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka (designated as Patthana 8.20) [SuttaCentral]. Structurally, it belongs to the dyadic (*duka*) matrices of conditional relations, analyzing phenomena through the framework of the fetters (*saññojana*) [SuttaCentral].

No curated cross-language parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are identified by SuttaCentral or detected with significant scores in DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, computational text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus reveals substantial internal reuse within the Pali canon, showing 310 matching passages shared with 55 other Pali texts, exclusively within the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. The largest alignments occur with related treatment of fetters and dyads, notably the *Saññojanagocchaka* (Patthana 2.4), the *Mahantaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.10), the *Saññojanagocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.5), the *Saññojanasaññojanasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.24), the *Āsavaduka* (Patthana 8.14), and other closely affiliated chapters [DharmaNexus].
